Hugo de Grootplein 1 3314 EG Dordrecht the Netherlands T +31 78 6332332 certin@nmi.nl www.nmi.nl This document is issued under the provision that no liability is accepted and that the applicant shall indemnify third-party liability. The notification of NMi Certin B.V. as Issuing Authority can be verified at www.oiml.org Parties concerned can lodge objection against this decision, within six weeks after the date of submission, to the general manager of NMi (see www.nmi.nl). OIML *(logo)* — MUTUAL ACCEPTANCE ARRANGEMENT INSPECTION RvA | 122 *(logo)* 101 --- # OIML Certificate of Conformity NMi *(logo)* **OIML Member State** The Netherlands Number R60/2000-NL1-14.23 Project number 14200416 Page 2 of 2 The conformity was established by the results of tests and examinations provided in the associated OIML Test Report(s): - No. NMi-14200416-01 dated 22 September 2014 that includes 51 pages. **Characteristics of the load cell:**
Maximum capacity (Emax)2000 kg up to and including 10000 kg
Minimum dead load20 kg
Accuracy ClassC
Rated Output2 mV/V
Maximum number of load cell intervals (n)3000
Ratio of minimum LC Verification interval Y = Emax / vmin7000
Ratio of minimum dead load output return Z = Emax / (2 * DR)6000
Input impedance350 Ω ± 3,5 Ω
Temperature range- 10 °C / + 40 °C
Fraction pLC0,7
Humidity ClassCH
Safe overload150 % of Emax
Output impedance350 Ω ± 3,5 Ω
Recommended excitation12 V AC / DC
Excitation maximum15 V AC / DC
Transducer materialStainless steel
Atmospheric protectionHermetically welded
The characteristics for nmax and Y can be reduced separately. Z is proportional or equal to nmax. Each produced load cell is provided with an accompanying document with information about its characteristics. The above identified Type (represented by the sample(s) identified in the OIML Test Report) have been found to comply with the additional national requirements established by the United States of America (NIST Handbook 44 and NCWM Publication 14), included in the MAA Declaration of Mutual Confidence: - R 60 DoMC-01 rev.0, Additional requirements from the United States; - R 60 DoMC-02 rev.0, Additional requirements from the United States. 101
